en.title: Sella Nevea holds 19 cm as Slovenia's snow cover drops 590 km² in a week
en.description: Slovenia lost nearly 600 km² of snow cover in seven days. Only 600 km² remain white as of 20 November, but high peaks still have good depth.
en.lede: Sella Nevea sits at 2137 m with 19 cm of snow on 20 November, the deepest and most stable site in Slovenia right now. The country has lost 590 km² of snow cover in the past week—a sharp fall from 1190 km² seven days ago—as lower elevations warm and melt.

p: Snow cover across Slovenia has shrunk fast. On 13 November, 1190 km² of the modelled area was white. By 20 November, only 600 km² remained—a loss of 590 km² in seven days. Yesterday alone, 160 km² melted as air temperatures rose. The country now sits at just 8 percent white cover overall.

This kind of retreat is not unusual in November. Early-season snow is thin and sits low; a few warm days erase it quickly. The Julian Alps have fared better than lower ranges because they hold the depth. Sella Nevea, the highest resort at 2137 m, is Slovenia's current leader with 19 cm. The Kamnik-Savinja Alps keep 46 cm from the past 72 hours, though measured depths at resorts there are still modest.

Snow now clings only to high ground. Above 2000 m, the mean depth is 22 cm and 100 percent of the area is covered. Between 1500 and 2000 m, 87 percent is white with a mean of 8 cm. Below 1000 m, there is almost no snow left—the snow line sits at 1500 m.

The Julian Alps are the exception: 54 cm fell there in the past 72 hours, well above the country average of 29 cm. This concentrated snowfall has kept depth and cover high in the range. Sella Nevea's measured 19 cm reflects this advantage, and the resort can expect another 30 cm over the next three days as a fresh system moves in.

sections.h: What the model sees across heights
p: Our snow model estimates the following depths by elevation band as of 20 November. From 500 to 1000 m: zero snow and zero cover. From 1000 to 1500 m: zero mean depth, but 7 percent of the area holds patches. From 1500 to 2000 m: 8 cm average with 87 percent cover. Above 2000 m: 22 cm average with full coverage.

These are model estimates for each band and may vary with slope angle, aspect and local wind. Measured station data confirm that the highest resorts hold the most reliable snow. Krvavec, at 1963 m, has 10 cm and is forecast to gain 23 cm in the next three days. Vogel, at 1731 m, has only 9 cm but sits in the path of the incoming system.

sections.h: Sella Nevea leads; the Julian Alps dominate
p: Sella Nevea is Slovenia's best site today with 19 cm measured on 20 November and 23 cm that fell in the past 72 hours. The resort sits high enough to have dodged the worst of the melt. It is forecast to gain 30 cm over the next three days—by far the largest increase among Slovenian resorts.

The Julian Alps as a whole received 54 cm of snow in 72 hours, making them the country's snowiest terrain. This range will continue to benefit as the forecast system moves through. Krvavec, in a different range, will gain 23 cm, making it a secondary target. Pohorje, the lowest and warmest range, received only 3 cm in 72 hours and will stay thin.

sections.h: The next three days: where the new snow falls
p: Slovenia is forecast to receive up to 18 cm of new snow over the next three days, with 17 cm possible on 22 November alone. This is the first significant snowfall for many lowland areas. The heaviest snow will again favour the highest peaks and the Julian Alps. Sella Nevea will capture 30 cm, Krvavec 23 cm, and Kranjska Gora 17 cm.

Lower resorts will see less benefit. Vogel will gain 14 cm, Kope only 12 cm. After 23 November, the forecast weakens: only 4 cm is expected in the second week (28 November to 4 December), so early December will be quieter. The window for skiing on fresh cover is now through 23 November.

The next seven days will bring up to 35 cm across the country, almost all of it in the first three days. After that, snow production drops sharply. Skiers looking for the best conditions should aim for the Julian Alps and Sella Nevea before 23 November.

Early-season snow is often thin and may not cover all terrain. Rocks and obstacles near the surface are common at these depths. Check the official avalanche bulletin before going off-piste. Use the SnowScope app to track where new snow is building in real time.

advice: Target Sella Nevea and the Julian Alps in the next 72 hours while fresh snow arrives—30 cm is forecast there, far more than elsewhere in Slovenia.
Stay above 1500 m: below that altitude, snow is patchy and unreliable. All remaining cover sits in higher bands.
Watch the 22 November forecast closely: 17 cm is expected that day alone, the peak of the incoming system.
Expect thin cover on many runs, especially off-piste. Early-season snow often sits shallow over rocks. Consult the official avalanche bulletin before leaving marked terrain.
Plan your visit before 23 November. After that date, snowfall drops to just 4 cm in the following week.

sl.title: Sella Nevea drži 19 cm, saj se snežna pokrajina Slovenije v tednu zmanjša za 590 km²
sl.description: Slovenija je v sedmih dneh izgubila skoraj 600 km² snežne pokrajine. Do 20. novembra ostaja belih le še 600 km², a visoki vrhovi imajo še vedno dobro globino.
sl.lede: Sella Nevea se nahaja na 2137 m nadmorske višine z 19 cm snega na 20. novembra, kar je trenutno najgloblja in najbolj stabilna lokacija v Sloveniji. Država je v preteklem tednu izgubila 590 km² snežne pokrajine—drastičen padec z 1190 km² pred sedmimi dnevi—saj se nižje ležeče nadmorske višine topijo.

p: Snežna pokrajina po Sloveniji se hitro manjša. 13. novembra je bilo 1190 km² modeliranega področja belega. Do 20. novembra je ostalo le še 600 km²—izguba 590 km² v sedmih dneh. Samo včeraj se je stopilo 160 km² snега, saj se je temperatura zraka dvignila. Država je sedaj pri le 8 odstotkih belega pokritja na splošno.

Ta vrsta umika ni neobična v novembru. Zgodnja sezonska sneg je tanka in leži nizko; nekaj toplih dni jo hitro izbriše. Julijske Alpe so se bolje odrezale kot nižja gorovja, ker zadržijo globino. Sella Nevea, najvišje smučarsko središče na 2137 m, je trenutni vodilec Slovenije z 19 cm. Kamniško-savinjske Alpe zadržujejo 46 cm z zadnjih 72 ur, čeprav so izmerjene globine na smučarskih centrih tam še vedno skromne.

Sneg se sedaj drži le na visokem terenu. Nad 2000 m nadmorske višine je povprečna globina 22 cm in 100 odstotkov področja je pokrito. Med 1500 in 2000 m je 87 odstotkov belih s povprečjem 8 cm. Pod 1000 m skoraj ni več snega—snežna meja je na 1500 m nadmorske višine.

Julijskie Alpe so izjema: v preteklem 72 urah je tam padlo 54 cm, daleč nad povprečjem države 29 cm. Ta koncentriran sneg je zadržal globino in pokritje na visokem nivoju na tem gorovju. Izmerjenih 19 cm Sella Nevee odraža to prednost, smučarsko središče pa lahko pričakuje dodatnih 30 cm v naslednjih treh dneh, ko se premakne svež sistem.

sections.h: Kaj model vidi preko nadmorskih višin
p: Naš snežni model ocenjuje naslednje globine po pasu nadmorske višine do 20. novembra. Od 500 do 1000 m: nič snega in nič pokritja. Od 1000 do 1500 m: nič povprečne globine, toda 7 odstotkov področja drži pegasto. Od 1500 do 2000 m: povprečje 8 cm z 87 odstotki pokritja. Nad 2000 m: povprečje 22 cm s polnim pokritjem.

To so ocene modela za vsak pas in se lahko razlikujejo glede na naklon terena, ekspozicijo in lokalni veter. Izmerjeni podatki postaj potvrjujejo, da najvišja smučarska središča drže najbolj zanesljiv sneg. Krvavec, na 1963 m, ima 10 cm in je napovedano pridobi 23 cm v naslednjih treh dneh. Vogel, na 1731 m, ima le 9 cm, toda leži v poti vhodnega sistema.

sections.h: Sella Nevea vodi; Julijskie Alpe prevladujejo
p: Sella Nevea je danes najboljše mesto v Sloveniji z izmerjenih 19 cm na 20. novembra in 23 cm, ki je padlo v preteklem 72 urah. Smučarsko središče je dovolj visoko, da je izognilo najhujšemu taljenju. Napovedan je pridobek 30 cm v naslednjih treh dneh—daleč največji pridobek med slovenskimi smučarskimi centri.

Julijskie Alpe kot celota so v 72 urah prejele 54 cm snega, kar jih naredi najbolj snežno teren države. Ta gorska veriga se bo še naprej koristila, saj se napovedani sistem premika naprej. Krvavec, v drugem gorovju, bo pridobil 23 cm, kar ga naredi sekundarno tarčo. Pohorje, najmanjše in najtoplejše gorovje, je v 72 urah prejelo le 3 cm in bo ostalo tanko.

sections.h: Naslednji trije dnevi: kje pada nov sneg
p: Slovenije je napovedan nov sneg do 18 cm v naslednjih treh dneh, z možnostjo 17 cm samo na 22. novembra. To je prva zajeten padavine za številna nizka področja. Najheavyest sneg bo ponovno koristil najviške vrhove in Julijske Alpe. Sella Nevea bo dobila 30 cm, Krvavec 23 cm, in Kranjska Gora 17 cm.

Nižja smučarska središča bodo videla manj koristi. Vogel bo pridobil 14 cm, Kope le 12 cm. Po 23. novembru se napoved oslabi: samo 4 cm se pričakuje v drugem tednu (28. november do 4. december), zato bo zgodnji december mirnejši. Okno za smučanje na svežem pokritju je sedaj do 23. novembra.

Naslednjih sedem dni bo prineslo do 35 cm po državi, skoraj vse v prvi treh dneh. Po tem pada proizvodnja snega drastično. Smučarji, ki iščejo najboljše razmere, bi se morali osredotočiti na Julijske Alpe in Sella Neveo pred 23. novembrom.

Zgodnja sezonska sneg je pogosto tanka in morda ne prekriva celotnega terena. Skale in ovire blizu površine so pogoste na teh globinah. Preverite uradno plazno bulletin, preden greste izven piste. Uporabite aplikacijo SnowScope, da spremljate, kje se novo sneg v realnem času gradi.

advice: Cilja Sella Neveo in Julijske Alpe v naslednjih 72 urah, medtem ko je sveži sneg na poti—30 cm je tam napovedano, daleč več kot drugod v Sloveniji.
Ostanite nad 1500 m nadmorske višine: pod to nadmorsko višino je sneg pegast in nezanesljiv. Vse preostalo pokritje je v višjih pasovih.
Sproti spremljajte napoved za 22. november: 17 cm se pričakuje samo tisti dan, vrhunec vhodnega sistema.
Pričakujte tanko pokritje na številnih progah, še posebej izven piste. Zgodnja sezonska sneg pogosto leži plitko nad skalami. Pred odhodom z označenega terena se posvetujte z uradno plazno biltenom.
Načrtujte obisk pred 23. novembrom. Po tem datumu padavine padejo na le 4 cm v naslednjem tednu.
